newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer, blue chips lead rebound.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer, blue chips lead rebound.

text.p: Leading UK shares snapped a five-day losing streak with a small bounce at the open on Wednesday, garnering support from a firm close on Wall Street, dealers said.

At 0746 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was up 13.7 points to 4,571.5, having closed at a four-week low on Tuesday. Advancers were ahead of decliners 58 to 28. Second-liners lagged, with the FTSE 250 up only 0.3 point to 4,462.3.
The Dow finished 22.75 points higher at 7,312.15 on Tuesday, lending support to leading UK shares.
